summary: Automated S4 gates pass, but Must-level delivery-resolution fidelity, exact-revision interactive 3D review, fresh LLM proof for every loadout, and direct sword-plus-shield regression evidence are incomplete.
blocking_findings: The Guard kite shield is upright but remains a near-black featureless slab and loses useful identity edge-on.
Long weapons become visually lost in narrow E/W views despite passing computed pixel thresholds.
The Traveler backpack is an oversized unarticulated cuboid.
Ranger armor, back, quiver, and waist equipment collapse into ambiguous rectangular volumes.
The Caster cape and pouch read as a rigid board and pasted-on block.
Exact-revision interactive 3D inspection was not completed.
Guard and Traveler fresh-LLM runs produced no session or Forge calls; the isolated Luna run did not execute.
The owner-required regression gate does not directly re-prove sword-down and shield-upright orientation together.
nonblocking_findings: Cloth physics, skeletal deformation, temporal animation, inventory, and external engine import are outside this track.
